scripts.start: nodemon --watch src --ext js,ts,json --exec 'npm run typecheck && sam build && sam local start-api'
scripts.docs:build: rm -rf docs/dist && mkdir -p docs/dist && cp docs/index.html openapi/openapi.yaml docs/dist/
scripts.docs: npm run docs:build && serve docs/dist -l tcp://127.0.0.1:3000
